9to5Mac Daily records new episodes Monday through Friday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player now, so you can listen the moment a new episode drops.

Today's stories:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 restores the App Switcher and adds new gestures
  • Apple is reportedly working on a Whoop-style, screen-less fitness tracker
  • What is going on with GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack thereof)?
  • Apple ends the unique AR experience at its Apple Park visitor centre
